steps.text: 日晷是倒计时：每走一步少一格，二十步走完这一趟就算失败。

texts.en: The sundial is the countdown: each step takes one notch. Use up all twenty and this trip fails.

steps.text: 这是体力：打输一场就少一点，用光了这一趟也结束。两个撤离点都不收钱，按 [key=map_fit] 看全图就能找到（滚轮缩放）。

texts.en: This is Vitality: each lost fight costs some, and when it runs out the trip ends too. Both extraction points are free; press [key=map_fit] to see the whole map and find them (scroll to zoom).
